description: Everything referenced in the AI Services Business course, organized in one place. Use these resources to land clients, deliver assessments, fulfill recurring concierge work, and handle sales objections.

resources.title: 1. The Mini AI Assessment Playbook
resources.description: A step-by-step playbook for running a free 15-minute mini assessment. It includes the discovery questions, meeting templates, research workflow, recommendation framework, and prep checklist for the follow-up call.

resources.title: 2. AI Tools Assessment Report Template
resources.description: The blank six-part report template used to package a paid AI tools assessment. Use it to present pain points, recommended tools, quick wins, implementation priorities, and projected financial impact.
resources.usageInstruction: IMPORTANT: Download the HTML file then drag & drop it into Claude Design with this prompt: 'Import a clean copy of the Assessment template attached'

resources.title: 3. The AI Concierge Playbook
resources.description: A detailed blueprint for structuring and fulfilling the recurring AI Concierge offer. It covers onboarding, twice-monthly working sessions, the Audit–Optimize–Automate process, client communication, and the back-end workflow that keeps fulfillment lean.

resources.title: 4. 8 Objections Every AI Services Prospect Raises
resources.description: Eight word-for-word responses to the most common objections that come up when selling AI services, including price, timing, and the belief that a prospect can simply figure it out themselves.

resources.title: 5. AI Operator Academy (Full Business in a Box)
resources.description: The complete AI Assessment and AI Concierge operating system including Claude skills, templates, client hub, intake workflow, onboarding plugin, and community support.

resources.title: 6. AI Services Business Full Course
resources.description: The complete video breakdown walking through how to structure, sell, and execute AI assessments and concierge services for SMEs.
